dedupe_keys.name: anonymized broadband measurements at community anchor institutions

description: Researchers at UC Santa Barbara, Northeastern University, UC Davis and Exactly Labs publish 1,980,286 broadband speed tests from 227 US community anchor institutions. Measurements span February 2022 to December 2024 and cover education, healthcare, government, libraries and community centres. The September 2026 release provides a compressed CSV, README and licence under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Each observation records an anonymous institution identifier, institution type, urban or rural classification, download and upload Mbps, latency in milliseconds and a UTC timestamp. These observations can calibrate service-quality variability in infrastructure and institutional-access simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this sample. All released tests use Ookla; separate M-Lab and comparison inputs from the paper are absent. Coordinates, local time zones, providers and access technologies are withheld. The sample is not a representative national census, and measurement bias or missingness was not independently checked.
